type: AI-powered multi-channel phishing and social-engineering detection platform
core_idea: Unify phishing defense across web URLs, email, text/WhatsApp/SMS, QR codes, deep website crawling, and voice/vishing. Each input is analyzed by ML, heuristics, external reputation signals, and optional LLM reasoning, then logged and streamed to a SOC-style dashboard.

repo_state.nested_app: /PhishGuard is a richer production/SaaS variant with auth, billing, admin, protected dashboard, mobile app, prod compose, and migrations.
repo_state.note: There is duplicated structure between root and /PhishGuard. Treat root as current demo surface and nested /PhishGuard as expanded production direction.
repo_state.whatsapp_bot: Folder exists but has no tracked implementation files; WhatsApp is mostly represented through text analysis/dashboard concepts.

clients.dashboard: React + Vite + Tailwind SOC console with panels for feed, crawl, voice, WhatsApp/text, QR, SMS simulator, geo map, alerts; nested version adds auth/settings/API token UI.
clients.extension: Chrome Manifest V3 extension scans links/Gmail/QR context menu, caches results, has offline URL heuristics.
clients.mobile: Nested Expo app supports URL scan, QR camera scan, voice upload, email/alerts screens.

backend.storage: PostgreSQL for detections/feedback/crawl reports/domain cache; nested version adds organizations, users, API keys, usage ledger.
backend.cache: Redis for external API cache and rate limiting.
backend.realtime: WebSocket feed for dashboard detections and SMS simulator.
backend.deployment: Docker Compose; nested prod stack includes Postgres, Redis, MinIO, backend, dashboard, Nginx, Playwright.

ml_pipeline.url: 38-feature URL extractor + XGBoost + VirusTotal + WHOIS + Qwen/Ollama reasoning.
ml_pipeline.email_text: TF-IDF/LogReg or DistilBERT-style classifier + extracted URL scoring + social engineering heuristics + Qwen reasoning.
ml_pipeline.voice: Whisper transcription + RoBERTa/BERT-style vishing tactic classifier + Qwen reasoning.
ml_pipeline.qr: OpenCV + pyzbar decode, then URL analysis for decoded URLs.
ml_pipeline.deep_crawl: Playwright crawler analyzes JS, forms, redirects, network requests, screenshots/visual similarity; enhanced/nested code references CodeBERT and CLIP.
ml_pipeline.ai_content: GPTZero/SVM-style AI text detector exists in ML modules/bootstrap plan.

data_flow: Relevant ML/heuristic/external enrichment modules produce score, verdict, signals, reasoning.
Detection is hashed/logged to DB with channel, threat_type, confidence, verdict, metadata.
Dashboard receives real-time event over WebSocket.
User feedback can be logged for later retraining.
product_strength: The sharp concept is omnichannel correlation: one detection brain and one live dashboard for attacks that move across links, email, messaging, QR, websites, and phone calls.
known_gaps: Root and nested trees are duplicated and should be reconciled.
Some docs describe planned modules more completely than root code implements.
Standalone WhatsApp bot is not present in tracked files.
Root app lacks nested SaaS auth/billing; nested app has it.
Some model assets are bootstrap/synthetic or placeholders and need production training data.

how_to_run.dashboard: cd dashboard && npm install && npm run dev
